WEST PAKISTAN DRUGS RULES, 1958
No. H‑S.O.‑III‑5‑1/58‑II,
18th September 1958, (Gazette Extraordinary, 20th September 1958).‑With
reference to West Pakistan Government Notification No. H.D.9/5‑56, dated
the 7th September 1958 and in super session of the Punjab Drugs Rules, 1945,
the Sind Drugs Rules, 1945 the North‑West Frontier Province Drugs Rules,
1945, made under former Government of Punjab, Sind and North‑West
Frontier Province with Notifications No. 8252‑M45/32700, dated the 21st
`December 1945, No. 756‑GC/36, dated the 22nd December 1945, and No.
2313/H‑Judl., dated the 21st January 1946, respectively, the Governor of
West Pakistan, in exercise of the powers conferred on by him by section 33 of
the Drugs Act, 1940 (XXIII of 1940), is pleased to make the following rules :‑------
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) These Rules be
called the West Pakistan Drugs Rules, 1958.
(2) They extend to the whole of
West Pakistan, except the Special Areas and the Federal Capital.
(3) They shall come into force
on such date as the Provincial Government, may by notification in the official
Gazette, appoint;
Provided that the Provincial
Government may direct that such of the rules applied by rule 2 of these rules
as may be specified in the notification shall take effect from such later date
as the Provincial Government may appoint.
2. Application of rule 2 and Parts V to X11 of the Central Drugs Rules, 1945.‑Rule
2 and Parts V to XII of the Central Drugs Rules, 1945, including the connected
forms and Schedules, shall apply to the whole of the Province of West Pakistan,
except the Special Areas and the Federal Capital as they apply to the Federal
Capital;
Provided that all references in
the said rules to the Central Government, the Government or the Chief
Commissioner, shall be deemed to be references to the Government of West
Pakistan.
